name: q8_predictive_ports_k16_unified_bath
parent_run: q8_predictive_ports_k64 (stopped by directive at step 890) and q8_predictive_ports_k64_unified_bath (stopped at step 470)

operators: unified three-layer field-only bath (gamma0 leakage, spectral viscosity, rank-R subspace forgetting)

belief.write_action: categorical common-port prediction plus event-norm-conditioned passive admittance: the port angle is atan(Y_c * ||delta||_Pi) with the precision-weighted site-averaged event-total innovation norm and its unit direction as incident mode

dissipation.context: field mean only (tok_embed is never passed on the W4 path)

layers.spectral_viscosity: learned nu times the exact continuous Laplacian spectrum, kills acoustic ringing and torus reverberation
layers.subspace_forgetting: learned rank-4 content subspace of the field mean, exponential decay along its directions

dissipation.note: The three layers are passive contraction semigroups composed once per microstep; the retired three-clock scheduling is irrelevant to their validity.

paths.note: Single-belief joint run; registered as the dissipation arm against the quadratic parent q8_predictive_ports_k64.

training.state_rule: field and precision persist across chunks and updates; truncation detaches gradient history only
training.objective: next-token NLL plus realized write-port free energy
training.read_action_kl: diagnostic until categorical action likelihood is marginalized

evaluation.kinetic_initializer: mature NESS spectrum with randomized Fourier phase plus saved channelwise precision
evaluation.headline: mean field-only next-token NLL

integrator.event_duration: 64 * tau0, preserved from the K=64 line
integrator.basis: zero-training two-axis probe on the parent step-500 checkpoint: coarser quadrature at unchanged evolution time costs +0.010 nats at dt=4*tau0 and +0.030 at dt=16*tau0, versus +0.473 nats for shortening the evolution time itself; K=16 is the knee of the precision curve
integrator.note: K is the quadrature resolution axis and T the duration axis; this change moves K only.
